# Generative_Model_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The structural arrangement of latent variables and their causal dependencies within an agent's generative model, which determines the flow of inference and control. Directly maps to physical interconnect topologies, allowing TCC to implement complex inference loops with minimal communication overhead.
